# seerr_radarr_service (Data Source)

Read Radarr service reachability, server summary information, and quality profiles from Seerr.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read all Radarr servers reachable by Seerr
data "seerr_radarr_service" "all" {}

# Read a specific Radarr server by ID and its quality profiles
data "seerr_radarr_service" "single" {
  server_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_id` (Number) Optional Radarr server ID to query. If omitted, all Radarr servers are queried.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this Radarr service query.
- `profiles` (Attributes List) List of quality profiles when querying a specific Radarr server_id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))
- `servers` (Attributes List) List of reachable Radarr servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Quality profile ID.
- `name` (String) Quality profile name.


<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `active_directory` (String) Active directory for the server.
- `id` (Number) Radarr server ID.
- `is_4k` (Boolean) Whether the server is configured for 4K.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default server.
- `name` (String) Radarr server name.
